paragraphs: I'm applying for the Associate, GTM Finance role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What stands out to me is that your GTM Finance team owns how Ramp allocates time and resources, and that's the kind of work I've done and want to keep doing.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts, models and scenario analyses to evaluate capital allocation, which improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation to weigh resourcing tradeoffs. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on marketing-channel budget allocation, built models to evaluate $10M in spend, and benchmarked past allocations to find 30% efficiency gains.

Owning models, building KPIs and dashboards, and helping operators decide where the next dollar goes is a close match to that background. I also worked in Thomson Reuters' order-to-cash process, where automation cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%, so I care about processes that scale. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
